limitations: This is sampled point-in-mesh evidence, not a volumetric boolean or continuous signed-distance field; narrow penetrations between samples can be missed.
At exact contact/intersection points, distance is zero by construction; this report separately samples involved garment triangle vertices and centroids.
A crossing pair can reflect a boundary/opening contact; pair counts are not defect counts.
Inside/outside classification assumes mannequin shell is closed and uses one oblique ray; sanity points are included.
No garment thickness/cloth simulation is modeled. QA/Lead must interpret clearances visually and decide G1.

decision: v2.1: 918/931 pairs include sampled garment surface points inside the mannequin; 13 are boundary/contact candidates with no sampled inside point. Treat as penetration evidence, not intentional seam contacts. v2.2: reduced contacts to 462, eliminating the screened cuff and front torso/hip/hem zones; residual contacts remain at neck/head/other boundary with sampled penetration to 8.98 mm. This is not clearance pass. Preserve candidate for Lead review and further correction/QA decision.
